For fixed t and prime p, conditioning on v_p(n)=a relative to r=v_p(t) yields joint-forbidden gamma_{p,k}(r), including p=2 cancellation case, and local good probability 1-2beta+gamma. CRT gives finite-prime exact densities and uniform high prime-power tail O(sum_{p>Y}p^{-T_k})+o_X(1), proving convergence of the product for fixed k>=2 and t!=0. Gamma=0 iff r<T_k since forbidden exponents are unbounded; hence exactly T_k-free minimizing shifts. Local factors are <=1-beta, with strict loss at p not dividing any fixed t; dominated convergence along factorial displacements gives supremum c_k (not attained), and covariance changes from negative at shift 1 to eventually positive at factorial shifts.
